appointments.description: Built and deployed MATREX VR, a portable, multimodal insect VR platform, for off-grid behavioural experiments with locusts, marching crickets, weaver ants and migrating moths.
Led innovation on contactless micro-vibration vitals monitoring; co-authored papers, patent applications and validation work; coordinated with clinicians on deployment in 200+ hospitals worldwide.
Prototyped an anosmia-screening IoT device and Android app, filed a patent application and deployed during the pandemic.
